sentence: Lawnchalashout fools the street. Jork chiquin fools no one.

wombos.definition: The quintessentially chill John Pork — the most perfectly relaxed, archetypal expression of John Pork energy.
wombos.example: He wasn't stressed at all — full jork chiquin mode.

wombos.definition: A nonchalashout staged on the front lawn — outwardly cutting grass, inwardly unraveling. Suburban-coded.
wombos.example: Dad's been mowing the same strip for an hour — full lawnchalashout.
